resources.string: Pansari Wala connects local kirana shops with nearby customers and delivery partners. Shop owners run PoS and inventory, customers order with voice search, and partners deliver with live tracking — no credentials or secrets are shown on this site.
Order from neighbourhood shops, search by voice, pay securely, and track delivery to your door.
Pick a shop → voice or text search → cart & pay → live partner tracking → OTP delivery.
Go online, accept nearby jobs, navigate to shop and customer, capture pickup, and complete with OTP.
Duty on → accept offer → navigate to store → pickup → navigate to customer → OTP deliver.
Shops — create, staff, active/deactive, address with location
Reports — sales, returns, orders, inventory, users
